title: Admin Panel Completion
instructions: Finish the WebCMS admin panel so all sections work with KosDB and SQLAlchemy. First fix settings save (site name currently does not persist). Then implement or wire up the remaining admin pages that are present in the React UI but not fully functional: ContentManager, MediaManager, UserManager, RoleManager, PluginManager, TemplateManager, ThemeManager, WorkflowManager, BackupManager, CacheManager, TenantManager, SearchManager, NotificationManager. Ensure every backend endpoint returns proper JSON, handles KosDB dict records, and persists changes.

1784367315.35624.instruction: Debug why saving site name in admin Settings does not persist. Fix both KosDB and SQLAlchemy paths in AdminAPI.update_settings() and AdminAPI.get_settings() so settings are read from and written to the database correctly. Verify with live test.

log.text: Identified settings save issue: KosDB commands silently fail and React sends numeric strings. Started fixing update_settings/get_settings, but file got a duplicate tail causing IndentationError. Cleaning up now.

Fixed AdminAPI.update_settings() and get_settings(): KosDB path now creates settings table with setting_key column, reads/writes via raw KosDB SQL; SQLAlchemy path now uses raw SQL to avoid ORM mapper issues. Verified SQLAlchemy path locally. Preparing to push for live KosDB verification.

Completed code fix in webcms/admin/admin_api.py for both KosDB and SQLAlchemy settings persistence. Verified SQLAlchemy path locally (defaults -> update -> persisted read). Attempted to push to GitHub for live KosDB verification, but git push times out in this environment (both SSH and HTTPS).

1784367317.6565092.instruction: Ensure /api/v1/admin/pages and /api/v1/admin/posts endpoints support list, create, update, delete with KosDB. Verify serialization handles KosDB dict records and SQLAlchemy objects. Test in admin UI ContentManager.

log.text: Inspected AdminAPI page/post CRUD; identified ContentManager is SQLAlchemy-only and will fail on KosDB. Preparing KosDB-aware create/update/delete paths.
Implemented KosDB-aware create/update/delete for /api/v1/admin/pages and /api/v1/admin/posts, verified serialization handles both KosDB dict records and SQLAlchemy objects, and validated with tests.

Completed KosDB-aware CRUD for /api/v1/admin/pages and /api/v1/admin/posts, verified serialization for KosDB dict records and SQLAlchemy objects via test_admin_content.py. Admin UI source is correct but dist rebuild could not be performed here due to missing npm/node_modules.

Implemented /api/v1/admin/media upload and list with KosDB-backed storage and mock fallback. Added lightweight multipart parser to Request.files. Updated MediaManager to support KosDB records, mock URLs, and SQLAlchemy. Verified with test_admin_media.py.

Implemented full CRUD for /api/v1/admin/users and /api/v1/admin/roles with KosDB, including user_roles association table, role seeding, and proper roles/permissions serialization for dict records. Added create_role and delete_role endpoints. Verified with test_admin_users_roles.py.
Fixed corrupted admin_api.py and verified users/roles tests pass.
